_source: Wiki (Museum Camp: each improvement's level, materials and experience; a hammer for all of them) and rsprox captures 73, local 1000187, 1000189, 1000410 (rev 227: building the cooking pot, the well and the spinning wheel, their refusals and their varbits). The cleaning bench, the sixth improvement, is built by FossilStorage.
_builds: Each improvement's multiloc (gameval) shows its built form when its varbit is 1; all six varbits are bits of varp 1632, which fossil_camp (bits 0-5) also reads. 'option' is the unbuilt form's cache option; 'built' is the recorded success line (bank chest and loom: not recorded, same pattern). 'tools' are kept; 'materials' are listed in the recorded order of the 'You need ...' line.

builds.name: Fire pit
tools: You need a tinderbox to build the cooking pot.

_nails: Any nails do (recorded: steel, gameval 'nails', and iron); the first kind held in full is used, lowest metal first.
_messages: level and missing are recorded (a game message and the same line in a message box); noHammer and the 'Nails' name in the missing line are ours (not recorded).

messages.level: You need at least level {level} Construction to build that.
messages.noHammer: You need a hammer to build that.

_buildTicks: Recorded: the build animation on the arrival tick, the materials, message and varbit the tick after.
